summary.text: Andrea Campbell is the incumbent Democratic Attorney General of Massachusetts, seeking a second term. A former Boston City Council president, she was elected attorney general in 2022 and has used the office to sue the Trump administration, enforce the MBTA Communities housing law and bring wage, consumer and landlord cases.

paragraphs.text: Campbell grew up in the Roxbury and South End neighborhoods of Boston and attended Boston Latin School, Princeton University and UCLA Law School.

She worked as a legal services attorney for children with disabilities and as legal counsel to Gov. Deval Patrick before winning a seat on the Boston City Council, where she later served as council president.
Campbell was elected Attorney General of Massachusetts in 2022 and became the state's 45th attorney general when she was sworn in on January 18, 2023.
